Creates the Delaunay triangulation of a set of points: the triangles that join them without crossing, as close to equilateral as possible.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** vector, delaunay, triangulation, TIN<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello, Silvia Franceschi<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.DelaunayTriangulation`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inMap` | vector file |  |  | The input points map. |
| `fElev` | String |  |  | The optional field with the elevation of the points. If not set, the z of the points is used, if they have one. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outMap` | output file |  | The output triangles map. |
